snippet.title: POOLSIDE VIGIL – Official Trailer | A Liminal Horror Experience V1.0
snippet.description:
POOLside VIGIL is a liminal psychological horror experience set inside an ever-shifting pool complex where space, memory, and safety slowly dissolve.

👉 Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4267630/POOLSIDE_VIGIL/

Explore a quiet, unsettling pool environment where rooms rearrange themselves and nothing feels permanent. Corridors loop, exits vanish, and familiar spaces begin to feel wrong.

There are no traditional deaths.
Instead, fear takes control through limited vision, fragile breathing, and loss of movement.
Your body weakens before your mind does.

The world reacts to your presence — sometimes when you are not looking.
Sometimes when you are.

This trailer focuses on atmosphere, isolation, and the constant feeling of being watched.

A playable demo will be available during Steam Next Fest.

POOLside VIGIL is an upcoming indie psychological horror game featuring liminal spaces, randomized environments, and experimental horror mechanics.
